## What changes for users

## How it was tested

- [ ] Tests were written first and `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] Public symbols have TSDoc with a compiling example; new errors have an `XLV_E_*` code and an entry in docs/errors.md
- [ ] Facts about formats or tools have a recorded source (docs/decisions.md or docs/facts/)
- [ ] No new runtime dependency (or the maintainer approved it and docs/decisions.md says so)
